drafts.draft_en:
AI is eating VFX 👀

One Seedance 2.5 prompt, zero compositing. Full shot, camera move, destruction and lighting in a single pass. Prompt below, steal it.
drafts.video_tip: 10-12s: open straight on the most violent VFX frame (building fold, portal, shockwave), no intro. One continuous camera move, then a hard cut to black with 'prompt below'. Full prompt in reply 1.

drafts.draft_en:
Prompt share: Paper Cut VFX 🎬

Paper cut-out [creature] tearing through a [city or landscape], layered paper shapes, visible fibers, handmade stop-motion jitter, soft studio light, shallow depth of field. Swap the brackets and show me yours.
drafts.video_tip: 4-image grid of the same template with different subjects, then a 5s animated version of the best one in Kling or Seedance with stop-motion stutter. Template text pinned in reply 1.

drafts.draft_en: Saturday Challenge 🎬 Your favorite song, but it's a music video from a decade it never existed in. Mine: Smells Like Teen Spirit (1958), drive-in edition. Drop yours below, best one gets featured next week.
drafts.video_tip: 12-15s in 4:3 with faded Technicolor, film scratches and a period title card, 3 beat-synced cuts. End card with the fake year. Rules in reply 1, ask for song suggestions.

drafts.draft_en: People say new models can now build full animations from code alone. So I tested the opposite: one sketch on paper, turned into a full VFX shot in under an hour. Your drawings deserve another dimension.
drafts.video_tip: 10s: 2s on a pencil sketch on a real desk, a page-turn transition into the 3D version moving in a lit cinematic scene, end on a side-by-side. Ask which sketch to bring to life next.

drafts.draft_en: New model drop week: GPT-6 Astra, Gemini 4, a rumored Claude Fable 5.5. Everyone is benchmarking code. I only care about one test: can it hold a VFX shot together for 10 seconds? Results soon. Which one should I try first?
drafts.video_tip: Teaser 8s: three blurred versions of the same VFX shot labeled A, B, C, with a 'results Friday' end card. Poll in reply 1 to pick the first model to test.
